Idea-pool bestiary

Three creature concepts for each new idea-pool tree, each with one hunter-style draft. Note the tree and number of the ones you like (for example blood_magic #3). On a phone, swipe each row sideways.

A ConversionB Hits taken and survivalC Turn gaugeD Debuffs, stacking, skill locksE Team size and modeF Tree and kit buildG Run rules

Lane AConversion #134

Iron Reflexes

iron_reflexes

No evade or graze; mitigation uses DEF + 0.6 x DEX.

Elemental Avatar

elemental_avatar

All its damage takes its own element and deals x1.25.

Fortress Fist

fortress_fist

Hits add 0.5 x DEF damage; STR and INT count as 0 for damage.

Blood Magic

blood_magic

Skills have no cooldown; each cast costs 6% max HP.

Lane BHits taken and survival #135

Resentment

resentment

Half the HP damage it takes becomes a red pool added to its STR, and each of its own actions drains a quarter of the pool.

Vantage

vantage

Below half HP, when an enemy aims a single-target attack at it, it strikes that enemy first, and cancels the attack if the strike kills.

Death's Door

deaths_door

Once per fight a killing hit leaves it at 1 HP; after that each hit is survived with odds that drop by 10% per hit already survived.

Barricade

barricade

Its shields never expire, and its shield cap rises to 60% of max HP.

Mana Ward

mana_ward

It starts each fight with a ward of 1.5 x WIS that soaks 30% of each hit, and while the ward holds its cooldowns tick 50% faster.

Lane CTurn gauge #136

Brave Heart

brave_heart

While unhurt or shielded it skips turns to bank up to 3 pips (and guards), then acts and spends every pip as extra actions in a row.

One More

one_more

A crit or strong-element hit refunds 40% of a full turn gauge, once per action.

Guard Break

guard_break

Enemies have 4 guard pips; each crit or strong hit strips one, and at 0 the enemy loses its next action and takes +50% damage.

Latent Power

latent_power

After its 8th action, all the unit's stats rise 30% for the rest of the fight.

Lane DDebuffs, stacking, skill locks #137

Hemorrhage

hemorrhage

Hits fill a bleed gauge that bursts for 15% of the target's max HP at 100.

Privileged Status

privileged_status

+40% damage against a target that has at least 2 active debuffs.

Equilibrium

equilibrium

A hit marks the target with its element; the next hit of another element deals +35% and clears the mark.

Corruption

corruption

Each active skill is cast twice at full power, then locked for the rest of the fight.

Dead Branch

dead_branch

Whenever one of its skills is locked, it gains a random active skill for the rest of the fight.

Lane ETeam size and mode #138

Lone Wolf

lone_wolf

Alone on its side at fight start, all its stats rise 40%; with allies, they fall 20%.

Arise

arise

Once per fight, the first enemy it kills (if not the last) rises on its side at 30% stats.

Last Rite

last_rite

When it dies, each living ally gains a share of 30% of its base stats for the rest of the fight.

Lane FTree and kit build #139

Mimic Core

mimic_core

Copies the capstone of the tree in the slot just before it, bought or not.

Heirloom

heirloom

Growth nodes get stronger the more you drill their stat after buying them (capstone doubles the step).

Mastery

mastery

A slotted tree with its capstone that wins 2 rank fights is mastered, and its capstone stays in the kit after the tree is overwritten.

Limit Break

limit_break

The tree's own stat can rise above STAT_MAX, up to 1299, for this monster.

Lane GRun rules #140

Iron Vow

iron_vow

Swear a vow: Rest is banned for the rest of the run, but every drill gains +25%.

Cursed Mark

cursed_mark

Drills stop giving DEF, but every enemy in run fights starts with -20% on all stats.

Devourer

devourer

Each rank-fight win steals 5% of the foe's best stat, but every cycle start costs 5 energy.

Second Breath

second_breath

Super drills refund their energy; drills below 30 energy can't injure and can't Super.

Ascetic

ascetic

+1 AP every cycle, but rank-fight wins give no SP.

Hungry Core

hungry_core

While fed, +60 to every trained stat; each cycle it eats 10 energy, or goes dormant if energy is short.
